item.title: Creating Reproducible Examples for Shiny Applications: Best Practices
item.description:
“Creating Reproducible Examples for Shiny Applications: Best Practices”

When seeking assistance or reporting issues with R Shiny applications, providing a high-quality, reproducible example is paramount. This ensures that those attempting to help can immediately recreate the observed behavior without needing external resources. The principles established for creating excellent reproducible R examples apply directly to Shiny development.

Data Integrity in Shiny Reproducible Snippets

How should one structure data within a Shiny example to guarantee independence from external files?
